title: Clean invoice, exact PO match
description: Northwind bills PO-1001 for exactly the agreed amount. Vendor approved, PO open, no duplicates.

title: Slightly over PO, within tolerance
description: Apex bills $68.75 over the PO value including tax (0.5%). Under the 2% / $100 auto-approve band, so it passes with a note.

title: Over PO beyond tolerance
description: Apex bills 8% more than the PO value. Beyond auto-approve but under the dispute threshold, so a person must decide.

title: Duplicate with altered invoice number
description: Meridian re-sends invoice INV-2041 as 'INV-2041A'. Same vendor, amount and date as one already paid.

title: Split PO: second milestone invoice
description: Brightwave bills $4,000 against PO-1004 ($12,000). $4,000 was already paid, so cumulative billing stays within the PO.

title: Split PO: invoice would overrun the PO
description: Brightwave bills $4,800 against PO-1008 ($10,000). With $6,000 already paid, cumulative billing would reach $10,800, over the PO.

title: Missing invoice number and date
description: Apex sends an invoice with no invoice number and no date. The process can't dedupe or age it, so it asks for exactly what's missing.

title: Scanned (image-only) invoice
description: Meridian's invoice arrives as a photographed scan with no text layer. OCR recovers the fields, then the normal checks run.

title: No PO reference on the invoice
description: Northwind quotes no PO. The process infers the PO from vendor + amount but won't pay on an inferred match alone.

title: Vendor not in the approved master
description: An unknown vendor submits an invoice quoting a real PO number. Quoting a PO is not proof of legitimacy.

title: Two-page invoice, totals on page 2
description: Northwind's invoice runs to two pages with 30 line items; the subtotal, tax and total only appear on page 2. All pages must be read and reconciled.

title: Credit note, not an invoice
description: Northwind sends a credit note for returned goods. It must never be paid, and it is linked to the invoice it credits.

title: Poor phone photo of an invoice
description: Meridian's invoice is a tilted, shadowed, low-resolution phone photo. If the scan is too poor to trust, a person confirms the values.
